The danger area is deactivated and goes back to yellow as soon as the activity is finished. Should there be a need for transit or use of the area, this can be coordinated with Andøya Space. Contact us on Phone 76 14 44 28, maritime channel 16 / 14 with call sign "Andøya Space". The operations center is staffed 1 hour before the launch window opens.
